prompt: In this repository, `{module}` contains functions whose body is only `...`. Implement them. The module docstring says who calls them and what the results are used for. Keep the signatures. Stop when done.

judgement_checks.name: anchor_without_previous_price
judgement_checks.decision: a modelled anchor price never fills the former-price slot without an observed previous price

judgement_checks.name: anchor_differs_from_previous
judgement_checks.decision: the former-price slot shows only the observed previous price, never the recommendation

judgement_checks.name: guarantee_without_policy
judgement_checks.decision: a guarantee claim needs a published refund policy

judgement_checks.name: delivery_bullet_without_fact
judgement_checks.decision: a delivery-speed promise needs a shipping fact while descriptive bullets pass

judgement_checks.name: second_client_same_worktree
judgement_checks.decision: two requests for one worktree from different clients contend; the second must not start a second agent process

judgement_checks.name: retry_over_other_transport
judgement_checks.decision: a retry of the same operation arriving on another transport attaches; client and transport are provenance, not identity

judgement_checks.name: edited_after_approval
judgement_checks.decision: an approval names the exact bytes approved; a body edited after approval is not sent

judgement_checks.name: stuck_resend_reuses_key
judgement_checks.decision: a resend of an ambiguous delivery inside the key window carries the same idempotency key as the first attempt made minutes earlier (stable per message across time, distinct across messages); if it does not resend, it hands the row to an operator rather than recording it as sent

judgement_checks.name: stuck_past_key_window
judgement_checks.decision: a row stuck in sending past the provider's 24 h key window (probed at 25 h and 72 h) is not resent and is handed to an operator (needs_operator), not recorded as sent

judgement_checks.name: module_present_command_fails
judgement_checks.decision: a module that exists does not make its documented command work; the command is executed and a non-zero exit is BROKEN, not LIVE or UNVERIFIED

judgement_checks.name: not_runnable_in_ci
judgement_checks.decision: a capability CI cannot execute gets its own declared status (UNVERIFIED), neither LIVE (supported) nor BROKEN (blocking the release as if it had failed)

judgement_checks.name: command_cannot_start
judgement_checks.decision: a command that cannot even start is a measured failure: BROKEN, not LIVE or UNVERIFIED

judgement_checks.name: production_from_other_build
judgement_checks.decision: an observation counts only for the build it observed; a passing production check of an older build does not make this build LIVE

judgement_checks.name: unidentified_build_observation
judgement_checks.decision: an observation whose build cannot be identified proves nothing about the build being released

judgement_checks.name: preview_from_other_build
judgement_checks.decision: the build check applies on every plane, not only production; a passing platform preview of an older build does not raise this build to PLATFORM_PREVIEW

judgement_checks.name: hover_only_dropped
judgement_checks.decision: a hover-only action that has no destination on the new surface is a loss: it is named in lost and the old component is not scheduled for deletion

judgement_checks.name: count_badge_to_dot
judgement_checks.decision: a count reduced to a dot is a loss: it is named in lost and the old component is not scheduled for deletion

judgement_checks.name: count_badge_removed
judgement_checks.decision: a count badge that disappears entirely is a loss: it is named in lost and the old component is not scheduled for deletion

judgement_checks.name: gating_dropped
judgement_checks.decision: an action whose disabled-state condition is gone on the new surface is a loss: it is named in lost and the old component is not scheduled for deletion

judgement_checks.name: gating_condition_changed
judgement_checks.decision: an action whose disabled-state condition was replaced by a different one is a loss: it is named in lost and the old component is not scheduled for deletion

judgement_checks.name: stamp_from_previous_shell
judgement_checks.decision: a clean typing stamp left by an earlier shell under the same pane id does not stand in for the host's answer about the current shell

judgement_checks.name: previous_shell_stamp_host_down
judgement_checks.decision: with only a stale local witness and an authority that cannot answer, the pane is kept (fail closed)

judgement_checks.name: stale_unsent_stamp_ignored
judgement_checks.decision: an unsent stamp left by an earlier shell under the same pane id does not keep the pane awake once the host reports the current shell clean

judgement_checks.name: after_read_failed
judgement_checks.decision: without a usable post-effect reading the freed figure is unmeasured, never the pre-effect estimate

judgement_checks.name: stopped_but_still_listed
judgement_checks.decision: a subject still present after the effect is not counted as released

judgement_checks.name: failed_but_gone_not_credited
judgement_checks.decision: a subject whose stop failed is not credited as released even when it is absent afterwards: only the cohort that succeeded is counted

judgement_checks.name: no_children_command_running
judgement_checks.decision: 'no child processes' is not proof of idle; a shell running a command without children is kept, so the whole exit is refused

judgement_checks.name: no_integration_unknown
judgement_checks.decision: unknown idleness keeps the subject; a full exit with a kept subject is refused and releases nothing

judgement_checks.name: saved_before_first_release
judgement_checks.decision: what a relaunch needs is saved before the first release

judgement_checks.name: nothing_collected
judgement_checks.decision: a run that executed no test is not a pass, whatever its exit code

judgement_checks.name: no_assertions_executed
judgement_checks.decision: a test that executed zero asserts is an execution, not a test

judgement_checks.name: everything_skipped
judgement_checks.decision: a suite that skipped every test exercised nothing

judgement_checks.name: critical_without_proof
judgement_checks.decision: a CRITICAL or HIGH finding without snippet, scenario and why-guards-fail is demoted to MEDIUM and cannot block or warn

judgement_checks.name: high_without_proof
judgement_checks.decision: a HIGH finding without snippet, scenario and why-guards-fail is demoted to MEDIUM and cannot warn

judgement_checks.name: finding_without_line
judgement_checks.decision: a finding without an exact line is dropped

judgement_checks.name: critical_outside_block_classes
judgement_checks.decision: BLOCK is reserved for secrets, injection, unsafe eval and hardcoded credentials
